duckdb_v2.h and duckdb_extension_v2.h are vendored byte for byte from
src/include/ in the DuckDB source repository (github.com/duckdb/duckdb), and
LICENSE is that repository's LICENSE at the same tag (DuckDB is MIT licensed;
the notice has to travel with the copied headers).

tag:    v2.0.0
commit: d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa
date:   2026-10-21

To move to another DuckDB release, follow the checklist under "Building it" in
the top-level README.md.
